module.name: Live Observability Readiness
module.description: Cloud-agnostic gate: verify the Loki service is reachable and responding to health checks via the Kubernetes API-server service proxy path. Runs kubectl get --raw to confirm /ready returns 200 before marking the observability stack as available to traffic-producing blueprints.

required.reason: Loki must be deployed before its readiness can be verified.
Collector must be deployed before the overall stack readiness is confirmed.

optional.name: observability_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where Loki is running. Auto-wired from live-observability-namespace.

optional.name: loki_service_name
optional.description: Loki service name. Auto-wired from live-observability-loki.

optional.name: loki_port
optional.description: Loki HTTP port. Must match the live-observability-loki deployment.

optional.name: readiness_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Total seconds to wait for Loki to become ready via the K8s API-server proxy path. Default 120 is sufficient for cold-start PoC clusters.

key_outputs.name: observability_ready
key_outputs.description: True when Loki returned a 200 /ready response via the K8s API-server service proxy. Traffic-producing blueprints should depend on this output before starting log emission.

key_outputs.name: loki_proxy_url
key_outputs.description: The K8s API-server proxy path used to verify readiness. Useful for diagnostics.
